name: demo
long: Demo manages widgets and the gadgets they hold.

commands.name: completion
commands.short: Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
commands.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for demo for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

commands.name: bash
commands.short: Generate the autocompletion script for bash
commands.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package.
If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(demo completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	demo completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/demo

#### macOS:

	demo completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/demo

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

commands.name: fish
commands.short: Generate the autocompletion script for fish
commands.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for the fish shell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	demo completion fish | source

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

	demo completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/demo.fish

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

commands.name: powershell
commands.short: Generate the autocompletion script for powershell
commands.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	demo completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.

commands.name: zsh
commands.short: Generate the autocompletion script for zsh
commands.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for the zsh shell.

If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need
to enable it.  You can execute the following once:

	echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit" >> ~/.zshrc

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(demo completion zsh)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	demo completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_demo"

#### macOS:

	demo completion zsh > $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/site-functions/_demo

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

commands.name: version
commands.long:
Show version information.

Displays:
  - version, commit and build date
  - the SDK version

commands.name: widget
commands.long:
Work with widgets.

Use this group to create and list widgets. Each widget lives in a 'demo.cue' file
under ./widgets/.

commands.name: create
commands.long:
Create a widget from a template.

	The template is read from --template <dir>, or the built-in one.

	Arguments:
	  name   The widget name, e.g. web_app
	         (kebab-case).

	Steps:
	  - render the template
	  - write the widget

	Examples:
	  # Create from the built-in template
	  demo widget create web

	  demo widget create web --template ./tpl
commands.example:
demo widget create api
  demo w create {{< x >}}
